### Fixes
- Rule changes save again on Obsidian 1.15. Adding, editing or removing a rule in the view's settings or in the view editor had no effect and never reached `data.json`, because Obsidian 1.15 renamed the Bases method that stores the edited filters (#37). Obsidian 1.11.10 through 1.14 continue to work.

### Also in this release (from the 0.5.2 beta)
- The HTML, CSS and JavaScript editors check your code as you type. A line with a problem is tinted, the exact spot is underlined, and a banner at the end of the line gives the message. Click the banner for every message on that line and a hint on how to fix it.
- Checks cover unclosed `{{ }}` and `{% %}`, block structure, expression syntax, unknown filters, functions and methods with "did you mean" suggestions, property names no note in the vault has, CSS brace balance and missing `:`, and JavaScript syntax errors. Errors thrown while the preview runs a script appear on the line that threw.
- Template editors in settings grow with their code up to 24em instead of always taking that height.
- Autocomplete and the problem popover are no longer clipped by the settings modal.

### Validation
- 1,331 automated tests pass, plus lint, browser typechecking and the production build. A new test reproduces #37 against the 1.15 query shape and fails without the fix.
- The fix was checked against Obsidian 1.15.0's own Bases code, which has `setFilters` and no `setGlobalFilters`. Mobile was not tested on a device.
